description: Elections Commission - Declare that E. P. N. Dharmadasa was Selected as the member of the Galewela Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette concerns the filling of a vacancy for a member of a local government body (Galewela Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It details the electoral process for replacing a member who ceased to belong to their political party, which falls under electoral processes and related matters.
